note: Tentacle template, the one tentacle of the specification (2026-11-10, step P4 first form; specification 2.1 to 2.4 and 3 and its addition of 2026-11-10 08:00 UTC), instantiated by nmnte::compose with {n} replaced by the tentacle index. One autonomous processing pathway, running in parallel with the others: the tentacle node (its own window over the whole code base for the question, cut into spans; the lens is a temporary specialisation), its drone tip (attention-head drone readers when a model is loaded, and the exact readers as further readers), its core (nmapi.tentacle_core: the neural tentacle core when a model is loaded, else the stated exact fallback core) and its g0_tx (nmbrain.g0, holding the core's state and report), which reports only to G1 (nmbrain.g1#g1 in core.json). No tentacle owns, stores or loads weights: one central copy is used by reference. The working-memory note hangs off the g0_tx. No edge leaves a tentacle except into G1. The earlier five-node territory template (PLAN 4d item 5) is kept as designs/assemblies/compose-context-territory.json, the graph served while --one-tentacle is off. Extra nodes a design adds must be registered components.

config.reads: own window over the whole code base, lens per question

readers: drones (attention heads; central weights by reference when a model is loaded)
lexical, semantic, deep (inside the window under window reach)
symbols, git, build, tests, uses, rules, interface (whole code base)

config.neural: nmapi::tentacle_core when a model is loaded (central weights by reference, none owned)
